title: check / DRC / DFM
observations: Schematic DRC with includeVerboseError=true returned a structured warning array (rule ATTRMATCHCODE, primitive ids) even though the documented return type is boolean; the receipt is usable as evidence.
PCB DRC returned a structured error-group tree (count 1: netlist mismatch because schematic changes were never imported on this sample) and realtime status false.
DRC acts on the active document: calling schematic DRC while a PCB document was active threw 'SCH_DrcUtil: doctype(3) not support check sch drc'.
No DFM-equivalent audit was found in the official surface (PCB_Drc has rules/check only); A's pcb check is a rebuild-based DFM audit.
risks: documented return type disagrees with the observed shape
active-document dependency; wrong doctype errors are easy to hit
DFM/process checks are out of scope for official DRC
